messages:
Samir K: Day 2 check-in — laptop imaged, VS Code + extensions installed, Docker build passes. Blocker: can't pull from internal registry (401). Also trying to join the onboarding lab at 11:00 — where's the link?

Marta (onboarding-bot): Welcome Samir! Quick checklist: have you accepted the calendar invite? The lab link is in the invite. If not, try /request-access or check #announcements for the Zoom link. Docs: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/labs

Jia L: Hey Samir — can you paste the exact docker error? I ran into this yesterday; usually it's an SSO group mapping.

Samir K: Error: `Error response from daemon: unauthorized: authentication required`. I ran `gcloud auth configure-docker` and still hits 401. My org email is samir@redwood.com.

Kyle: Samir K: I just added you to k8s-infra and registry-read groups, try again now. Registry is `gcr.io/redwood-infra` — example: 
```
docker pull gcr.io/redwood-infra/base:latest
```

Samir K: Pull succeeded, thanks Kyle :tada:

Samir K: One more blocker: can't read devbox secrets from Vault — `permission denied` when running `aws ssm get-parameter --name /devbox/ssh_key`.

Infra-bot: Ticket created: #INC-4872 — Vault permission request for samir@redwood.com. Assigned to infra-team, ETA ~3h.

Jia L: For Vault it's often the IAM role mapping; if ticket takes long I can do a quick shadow session at 2pm to validate.

Samir K: That would be great, thanks. Today plan: finish quickstart app, run unit tests, shadow QA pairing at 3pm. No other blockers right now. Ping @Jia if anything else pops up.

Marta (onboarding-bot): Reminder: complete security training and sign the Laptop AUP by EOD. Also join the weekly new-hires drop-in today at 4pm. :smile:

Kyle: Quick ping — when you get a minute, could you skim PR #412 (onboarding docs) and leave any nits? No rush.

Samir K: Will do after tests finish, thanks everyone!
